name: calcbj-web
description: CalcBJ in the browser: blackjack advantage calculator (Svelte interface, Rust engine as WebAssembly)

scripts.build: npm run wasm && npm run check && vite build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run wasm && npm run check && vite build --mode desktop
scripts.build:android: npm run wasm && npm run check && vite build --mode android
scripts.build:ios: npm run wasm && npm run check && vite build --mode ios
